For reference only — the rest is not adjusted from this.
• HR coming back faster can mean you have adapted, or that fatigue is building up (Bellenger 2016 meta-analysis, Aubry 2015).
• For the same person in the same test, the 60-s heart-rate recovery varies by about 25% from day to day (Buchheit 2014), so one session can't show a change.
• Later reps come back more slowly anyway (Rushall 2015, Shun-Cheng Wang).
• AeT is your measured aerobic threshold, standing in for the 70% of heart rate reserve Kuo-Feng Hsu uses (Kuo-Feng Hsu: how many seconds HR takes to fall back to that line, compared across the same workout).
• The old "60-s drop under 20 beats → lengthen the rest" rule had no training source and is gone; 20 beats is close to the clinical post-exercise heart-rate recovery cut-offs used to screen heart risk (Cole 1999, Cleveland Clinic), not a rule for the rest between reps.

你的輕鬆路跑速度對應的強度比（Intensity）。課表裡用距離寫的段，用這個數: The intensity your easy road-running speed corresponds to. A step written as a distance gets its speed by interpolating between this number and your threshold pace, which sets how long the step takes and how much training load it counts. Your value = the median intensity of your easy flat road runs over the last six months (average HR ≤ AeT + 3, under 15 m of climb per km, 20 minutes or longer); 1 data point = one such run. Without power, the intensity from heart rate or pace is used. It only changes the plan's training load, never a workout already sent to the watch.

用 RPE 當目標的步驟（技術地形、下坡）照「RPE 對 % CP 表 × 這個: A step with an RPE target (technical terrain, downhill) counts at "the RPE-to-% CP table × this number", which sets its training load. Your value = your runs with a self-rated RPE over the last year: an RPE value counts once it has at least 3 runs, its median actual intensity ÷ the table's value, averaged by the number of runs; 1 data point = one rated run. A rating is how the whole run felt (warm-up included), so this is an estimate. It only changes the plan's training load, never a workout already sent to the watch.
